tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khyog po ri khrod kyi gnas bshad bzhugs/ /

oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i gnas kyi yang dben rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa ni/ sgrub gnas mkha' spyod bde ldan zhes bya ba 'di yin la/ sa'i mthil chos 'byung gru gsum lta bu/ lung pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba 'dra ba/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi dbyibs can/ mdun ri 'bru'i phung po la rin po che'i 'phraing ba lan gsum du g.yogs pa 'dra ba/ lho'i ri rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa las/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'babs pa lta bu/ lho nub kyi phyogs na rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi ri mthon po/ chu skyes kyi ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i dbus nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa/ de'i drung na dngos grub 'byung ba phag mo'i dur khrod dang bcas pa/ de dang nye ba'i g.yas kyi ri la dung dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad tshang ba/ rgyab ri bdud rtsi can gyi shing gi nags tshal gyis khebs pa/ sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i ri bo rtse mo gsum pa rigs gsum mgon po'i tshul du bzhugs shing*/ g.yon gyi phyogs na brag rgyal po chen po sde bzhi chos nyan pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brag phug pad+ma rā ga la sogs pa sgrub gnas dge mtshan can du ma'i dbus na/ brag ri rdo rje rtse lnga pa lta bu'i steng du/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku kun spangs kun tu bzang pos sgrub gnas chen po mdzad/ byang sems chen po dang mkhas btsun chen pos kyang rim can du bzhugs/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos kyang lo gnyis ngo gsum bzhugs/ sor sdud bsam gtan srog rtsol gsum mthar phyin pa'i tshul ston sa yang 'di lags/ de rjes dam pa de nyid kyi thugs sras bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po zhes bya ba/

'khrungs yul dbu ru stod pa yin/ dgon pa sprin chen du rab byung mdzad/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang zhabs la thug /chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i drung du rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i 'khrid zhus nas/ gnas 'dir sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad pas bla ma mkha' spyod par grags/ srog rtsol gyi gegs byung ba yang kun mkhyen chen pos sel bar mdzad/ de nas mngon shes khyad par can 'khrungs te/ mkha' spyod kyi mun khang du bzhugs bzhin pa nas/ dgon pa nags phug gi gtsug lag khang gi gsung rab po ti thams cad chos 'don byed pa bzhin du klog thub pa dang*/ gzhan yang mngon shes thogs med mnga' ste/ 'on kyang yon tan thams cad sbas pa'i tshul du mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po sku bzhugs pa'i ring la 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin phyis gzims khang du khong rang gcig pu bzhugs pa la/ phyi nas nyan dus rol mo'i sgra grag pa yang yang byung*/ nang gcig rol mo'i sgra shin tu yun ring ba zhig byung nas/ gzhan rnams kyis lta bar phyin pas/ na bza' shul har re lus 'dug ste/ gnas skabs de nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pas/ sngar bla ma mkha' spyod pa zhes mtshan thogs pa yang don dang ldan par song ngo*/ /de ltar na skyes bu dam pa de mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gnas 'di yin cing*/ de rjes su skyes bu dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa lags so/ /sgrub gnas las kyang sgrub gnas mchog gi phul/ /dben gnas las kyang yang dben 'khyog po'i brag /ngo mtshar las kyang ngo mtshar rmad byung gnas/ /nyams dga' las kyang nyams dga'i ting 'dzin 'phel/ /lung pa'i mthil gyi ri dang sa gzhi dang*/ /chu rnams 'dus pa e yig chos 'byung 'dra/ /bar gyi cha ni pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /dri med nam mkha'i ngos ni 'khor lo 'dra/ /shar ri rin chen 'bras bu'i phung po dang*/ /lho yi ri ni rgyal ba tshe dpag med/

/nub dang bden bral rnal 'byor ma dpal dbyibs/ /byang gi phyogs na mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i phug /rgyab ri rigs gsum mgon po lta bu la/ /g.yon nas rgyal chen bzhi yi chos nyan tshul/ /gnas kyi lte ba rdo rje rtse lnga 'dra/ /brag ri rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i steng*/ /bla ma'i gzims khang mkha' spyod bde ldan zhes/ /grub rigs bye ba phrag brgyas brten pa yod/ /rtsa gsum rnam par dag pa mtshon byed du/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chu rgyun gsum yang 'bab/ /bsil dang dro dang bsil drod snyoms pa ste/ /nus pa'i khyad par rtsa dang mtshungs pa yin/ /gnas mchog 'di ru phyag dang bskor ba dang*/ /byin rlabs sgrub chu 'thungs dang khrus byas pa/ /de dag thams cad bde 'gro bzang por 'gro /lan gcig tsam gyis bar chad sel ba dang*/ /lan mang bskor bas sdig sgrib thams cad 'byang*/ /gnas mchog 'di yang rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa e ma ho/ /gnas kyi srung ma gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul can/ /che btsan dpa' bo brag rje zhes bya bar/ /ming 'dogs bsgyur nas bka' yi srung ma mdzad/ /lta ba rnam dag dbu ma chen po la/ /nges pa rnyed nas zab lam mthar thug pa/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig bsgom pa la/ /rtag tu g.yel ba med par 'phrin las sgrub/ /lta grub gzhan dang zog po tshul 'chos mkhan/ /log spyod can la chad pas gcod pa'i phyir/ /gnas 'di shin tu gnyan zhes grags pa byung*/ chos bzhin spyod pa dge ba'i ngang tshul can/ /bsdad pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin ngang gis skye/ /cung zad goms na lhag par bogs bskyed che/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi/ /dge mtshan rten 'brel thams cad 'dus pa yin/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs dang gnas 'di bskor ba sogs/ /rnam dag legs lam 'brel pa 'jog pa rnams/ /bde skyid phun tshogs sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/de dag ni phyi'i gnas bshad yin la/ nang gi rten bshad sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar te bshad do/ /'khyog po ri khrod kyi gnas bshad dge'o// zhus dag/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khyog po ri khrod kyi gnas bshad bzhugs/ / - PAGE 158 -- PAGE 159 -- PAGE 156 -
